execution.task: Create only test_checkout.py for checkout(stock, prices, sku, quantity) in orders.py, which calls inventory.reserve. Do not modify implementation. Stock maps SKUs to nonnegative integer counts; prices maps SKUs to nonnegative numbers; quantity is an integer. Success returns price*quantity and decreases only the selected stock count by quantity, allowing exact exhaustion. Test integrated behavior using fresh dictionaries, multiple quantities and unrelated SKUs, without mocking reserve.
